thread:
incident-bot: [PAGER] Elevated warmup failures on serving-pool gpu-a in eu-central-1 — 60% warmup errors over 3m. Paging oncall.

harry (oncall): I'm oncall, looking at the warmup stack traces. Initial hits show deserialization exceptions followed by kernel compile timeouts. Example: `DeserializeError: unexpected EOF while reading weights` then `CompileTimeout: kernel_jit timed out after 30s` and node kube-gpu-a-7 reports container crash loop.

maya-sre: seeing artifact download failures in logs from object-store: `http 206 partial content` around 02:06:12 UTC, then the runtime tries to deserialize a truncated weight file. Might be flaky transfer.

srujan: stack excerpt from kube-gpu-a-7: ```[ERROR] deserialize_weights failed: invalid magic header
[WARN] falling back to compile JIT
[ERROR] kernel_jit: timed out after 30s, aborting
[CRIT] oom when allocating 4.1GB for compiled kernel
```

taylor-cs: customers flagged: GammaRetail observed 504s for ~4m (02:05-02:09 UTC). I notified them and opened a ticket.

harry (oncall): immediate actions: 1) pause scheduled warmups for model mistral-30b-v2-quant across pool gpu-a, 2) cordon + drain kube-gpu-a-7 to stop flapping, 3) switch routing to standby pool gpu-b which has quantized variant mistral-30b-q4. Applying now.

maya-sre: pausing warmup: `curl -X POST https://control-plane/api/pools/gpu-a/warmup/disable -d '{"model":"mistral-30b-v2-quant"}'` -> accepted.

deploy-bot: rollout: update route /v1/chat -> prefer mistral-30b-q4 weight 100% (applied).

infra-bot: cordon initiated: kube-gpu-a-7 cordoned at 02:08:03 UTC, draining pods. Node reports `kernel: panic` before last kubelet heartbeat.

srujan: clearing compile cache on node before bringing back: `ssh node@gpu-a-7 sudo rm -rf /var/lib/runtime/compile-cache/*` and clearing artifact temp dir `/var/tmp/model-fetch/*`.

harry (oncall): increase compile timeout on pool config to 90s temporarily (KERNEL_JIT_TIMEOUT=90) to allow slower JIT to finish if it's just slow. Also set MAX_WARMUP_CONCURRENCY=1 for mistral-30b family.

maya-sre: config patched: `kubectl set env deploy/serving-runtime KERNEL_JIT_TIMEOUT=90 MAX_WARMUP_CONCURRENCY=1 -n inference` -> rollout 6/6 pods.

taylor-cs: GammaRetail confirmed traffic shifted and errors decreased to baseline after 5m. They're asking whether any requests were retried or lost.

harry (oncall): no user data loss — requests that hit failed warmups were routed to fallback model. Logging shows 12 requests returned 503; all clients were retried by edge LB. We'll include full timeline.

srujan: investigating root cause: object-store reported transient S3 read timeouts for range GETs during larger artifact downloads. Hypothesis: partial downloads lead to truncated artifacts, deserialization hits unexpected EOF and runtime falls back to JIT which then times out and can OOM on compiled kernels.

maya-sre: ran local reproduce: `./inference --model mistral-30b-v2-quant --fetch-only --checksum` -> fetch failure when simulating 206-range failure, checksum mismatch triggers abort. Need stricter integrity checks on fetch path.

harry (oncall): short-term mitigations to avoid pager churn: - enable artifact checksum verification during warmup and fail fast before JIT, - limit concurrent JITs per node to 2 (JIT_CONCURRENCY=2), - add auto-retry with exponential backoff on incomplete range requests.

deploy-bot: patch applied for fetcher: CHECKSUM_VERIFY=1, JIT_CONCURRENCY=2. Rollout successful (6/6).

srujan: note: bringing kube-gpu-a-7 back is blocked until hardware health check; infra team to inspect machine for ECC errors.

infra-bot: maintenance task created: INFRA-9003 investigate gpu-a-7 ECC and NIC logs.

taylor-cs: customer comms: sending out timeline and mitigation summary to GammaRetail, offering 1:1 postmortem call.

harry (oncall): prepping handoff to SRE oncall at 03:00 UTC. Remaining work: artifact integrity check in object-store, add range-GET telemetry, consider defaulting CHECKSUM_VERIFY=true for warmup, and review compile cache growth policy (old entries causing eviction thrash).

maya-sre: added follow-ups: STORAGE-112 implement range-get retry + metrics, RUNTIME-845 abort-on-bad-artifact, OBS-478 dashboard for JIT failures per node.

incident-bot: incident recorded: 2026-03-15-2350006789.

harry (oncall): handing off to maya-sre. All temporary mitigations applied, routing stable, GammaRetail impact contained. I'll be available for questions until 03:15 UTC.

maya-sre: acknowledged handoff. Will keep monitoring and update incident ticket with timeline, root cause analysis, and remediation plan.

incident-bot: thread closed for active paging. Please update incident task list and tag owners. :white_check_mark:
